terra.problem: The ice joke has no clear connection to the vision or an everyday situation.
The text does not say whether the cloud is cold.
The joke about not keeping up with his one face has no clear meaning or everyday comparison.
“Those are animals” is a generic observation that adds little to the explanation.
Papa describes himself backing out of a parking spot. Things outside his bakery, such as cars, are things people do, not things he does.
Papa guesses why Ezekiel chose his words. He must not add reasons for someone's actions unless the text gives them, even as a guess.
Saying Ezekiel describes what he sees as carefully as he can adds a claim about his effort that the text does not give.
The text compares the light to a rainbow in a cloud; it does not put the light itself in a rainy-day cloud.
Ezekiel says he heard a voice, not that he was listening. The explanation adds his attention as a fact.
